name: Create a user
description: Create a user Creates a new user. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/users
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/users
Creates a new user.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete a user's MFA device
description: Delete a user's MFA device Deletes a specific MFA device, including a PIV key or FIDO2 key enrollment, for a user. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/users/{user_id}/mfa_authenticators/{authenticator_id}

name: Delete a user
description: Delete a user Deletes a specific user for an account. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/users/{user_id}

name: Get single active session
description: Get single active session Get an active session for a single user. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/users/{user_id}/active_sessions/{nonce}

name: Get active sessions
description: Get active sessions Get active sessions for a single user. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/users/{user_id}/active_sessions
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/users/{user_id}/active_sessions
Get active sessions for a single user.
Required: user_id (path); account_id (path)

name: Get failed logins
description: Get failed logins Get all failed login attempts for a single user. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/users/{user_id}/failed_logins
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/users/{user_id}/failed_logins
Get all failed login attempts for a single user.
Required: user_id (path); account_id (path)

name: Get last seen identity
description: Get last seen identity Get last seen identity for a single user. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/users/{user_id}/last_seen_identity
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/users/{user_id}/last_seen_identity
Get last seen identity for a single user.
Required: user_id (path); account_id (path)

name: Get a user
description: Get a user Gets a specific user for an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/users/{user_id}

name: Get users
description: Get users Gets a list of users for an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/users
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/users
Gets a list of users for an account.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: name (query); email (query); search (query); page (query); per_page (query)

name: Update a user
description: Update a user Updates a specific user's name for an account. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/users/{user_id}
